title: Clamp trust last_seen across wall-clock regression
description: Correctness review finding in python/src/lichen/crypto/trust.py: verify_or_pin (line 450), verify_peer (line 495), and add_trust_anchor (lines 539/546) replace last_seen with raw time.time(). If the wall clock steps backward below first_seen, TrustEntry validation raises and blocks an otherwise-valid peer; smaller regressions silently decrease last_seen and persist non-monotonic recency. Clamp new timestamps to at least the existing last_seen (and first_seen) and add regression tests for all mutation paths.
